fields.label: Destinations
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_map_places
fields.instructions: Destinations shown as gold names on the map. Selecting one opens a popup with its image, description, and link. Destinations are also listed as text when the map cannot load.

sub_fields.label: Name
sub_fields.name: name
sub_fields.instructions: Shown on the map in capital letters, for example “Tahoe City”.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional landscape image shown at the top of the popup. It is decorative because the destination name appears directly below it.

sub_fields.label: Region
sub_fields.name: region
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, shown under the name in the popup, for example “North Shore · California”.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Longer text scrolls inside the popup.

sub_fields.label: Latitude
sub_fields.name: latitude
sub_fields.instructions: Decimal degrees, for example 39.18. In Google Maps, right-click the place and copy the first number.

sub_fields.label: Longitude
sub_fields.name: longitude
sub_fields.instructions: Decimal degrees, for example -120.127 (negative in North America). The second number copied from Google Maps.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Use a descriptive link text such as “Explore Tahoe City”; a link without text is not shown.

fields.label: Attractions
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_map_attractions
fields.instructions: Points of interest shown as icons. The name appears when a visitor hovers, focuses, or taps the icon.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the icon that best describes the attraction.

fields.label: Snow effect
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_map_snow
fields.instructions: Show falling snow over the map. Visitors can pause it with the map control, and it starts paused for visitors who ask their device to reduce motion.
